inspiration: test_decompiling_nl_i386_pie; angr CLE PLT/GOT import resolution + libc no-return database; usage
testing_deviation: No tests/stages/ghangr-*.xml: the bytechunk stage harness cannot carry .rel.plt/.dynsym/GOT structure to reach the PLT/no-return loader path. Gated instead by a kuna-console integration test over a vendored i386-PIE ELF fixture + an elf_plt decoder unit test (approved proposal sub-decision B).
scope: small (one loader-function fix + option wiring), routed via [PROPOSAL] for human go/no-go due to: analysis-tier loader (not a kuna-decomp Action/Rule), default-behavior change for the i386-PIE binary class, and the stage-harness gap. Approved; implemented default-on gated.

decisions.question: Sub-decision A: ship the i386-PIE PLT decode unconditionally (like the sibling x86-64/aarch64 decoders) or gate it behind a default-on option?
decisions.resolution: Gated, default-ON, option `i386_pie_plt`. Honors the standing 'output-changing => --option-flaggable' requirement and the worker's LLM-discoverable-option Definition of Done, while default-on matches the decider's loader-fidelity recommendation. The OFF path restores byte-identical pre-fix output (the before-image / escape hatch). Because the PLT->name map is baked at `load file` (upstream of `option`), the loader reads the gate via the `KUNA_I386_PIE_PLT` env var; the `Architecture::analysis_i386_pie_plt` bool is for catalog visibility only.

decisions.question: Sub-decision B: how to test a loader-tier feature the stage XML harness cannot reach?
decisions.resolution: Vendored i386-PIE `nl` ELF fixture (decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/i386_pie_nl, 48 KB) + a kuna-console integration test (verify_i386_pie_plt.rs, precedent verify_aarch64_plt.rs) asserting named libc calls and the absence of the spurious do{}while(true)/goto/sub_<addr>, plus a focused decoder unit test (elf_plt.rs::tests::i386_pie_plt_decode covering the FF A3 on/off paths and the unchanged FF 25 arm).

decisions.question: Original scope decider verdict (verbatim, from the approved proposal).

decider_verdict.rationale: One-function loader-fidelity fix, the precise i386-PIE analog of the already-shipped x86-64 RIP-relative and aarch64 veneer decoders. decode_i386 already handles the non-PIC FF 25 <abs32> form and merely needs the PIE FF A3 <disp32> form, got = GOT_base(_GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE_ / .got.plt) + disp32 (verified: 0x9edc + _exit disp 0x14 = 0x9ef0 = the R_386_JUMP_SLOT r_offset). The downstream no-return cascade is pre-existing machinery that just needs the name. Blast radius on the 675 datatests is provably zero.
